# Claude Code question picker, recorded 2026-08-31 (pair#464)

Re-rendered like `../2.1.296/` (one synchronized frame of cells, attributes and
cursor), from the `arc-agi-2` pane's recording at 80×38. The Claude Code
version isn't in the stream; this predates 2.1.296.

- `question-picker.raw`: an AskUserQuestion picker with the cursor on its
  free-text row, `❯ 4. Type something.`, at column 0 between two `─` rules.
  That is the closest a picker comes to the composer's shape. The recognizer
  declined all 15 picker frames in the recording, so the picker latch's screen
  close (pair#464) must not read it as the composer coming back.
